value.title: Hard-gate thresholds HC-05..HC-12 of the assessment layer (A9.24 item 5); physics / design modules hold none of these values (HC-09 is also the design-generation filter, read from the engineering constraints)
value.rule: read by abep_sim.configuration.load_gate_thresholds for the assessment layer (abep_sim/assessment/design_gates.py HARD_CONSTRAINT_LIMITS); a CONSTRAINT_REFERENCE gate carries no value (single source: the engineering constraints, x scale_to_gate_units); a TBD gate has value null and evaluates NOT_EVALUATED; changing a threshold changes the assessment only, never raw physics

HC-05.criterion: M_n,LB > 0, where M_n = I_e,cap / I_d,max,H1 - 1 and M_n,LB is its lower uncertainty bound; the point difference I_e,cap - I_d,max is never the acceptance criterion; without uncertainty evidence (a lower bound) for the inputs HC-05 is NOT_EVALUATED; physics produces the currents and their uncertainties

HC-06.criterion: temperature margin >= 50 K below the validated hardware-bound temperature limits (config/hardware/hardware_bounds_v1.json index); applied by assessment / protection logic, never inside thermal equations; physics produces temperatures / heat loads
provenance: registered protection / acceptance margin (former HC-06 literal THERMAL_MARGIN_MIN_K)

HC-07.criterion: predicted / measured subsystem firing life > the 15,000 h subsystem firing-life basis; the mission duration (26,280 h, operating scenario) is separate

HC-08.criterion: T_available(state) - D_spacecraft(state) >= 0 at every required state (statewise); physics computes T and D independently
provenance: AG-13, owner decision A9.13 S6.15 (former HC-08 literal STATEWISE_T_MINUS_D_MIN_N)

HC-09.criterion: intake-face drag <= 25 mN at every orbit state: F1-F8 design-generation filter (A9.22 G2 Option 1, read from the frozen engineering configuration, not RFP parsing) and reported in assessment; assessment-only (C-DRAG-RFP Option 2) needs a separate owner approval

HC-10.criterion: ambient atmospheric mode AND Xe contingency capability evaluated as architecture / capability evidence (1 = both demonstrated); no physics equation carries this requirement
provenance: A9.15 RFP-compliant propellant policy (former HC-10 literal PROPELLANT_CAPABILITY_MIN)

HC-11.criterion: feed_available - feed_required >= 0 (statewise feed-state sufficiency, registered formulation: minimum relative field margin); the requirement comes from the measured / validated H-1 performance basis when available and is never reduced to the presently achievable feed
provenance: AG-12, owner decision A9.13 S6.21 (former HC-11 literal FEED_STATE_SUFFICIENCY_MIN)

HC-12.criterion: compressor / plenum ripple <= measured H-1 ripple tolerance; threshold TBD until measured H-1 evidence establishes the permissible ripple basis; no default is invented

changes: firing_hours: CONSTRAINT_REFERENCE -> OPERATING_SCENARIO_CHOICE value 15000 h (unchanged value), initial_basis firing_life_h (provenance only); independent of the HC-07 threshold

wet_mass_limit_kg and altitude_domain_km references removed: the 40 kg wet-mass limit is an engineering / assessment constraint (and an explicit design-synthesis filter where used), never an operating-scenario input; the altitude band is a frozen domain constraint validating the frozen 196-state design-state set, which is the actual physics environment input

HC-05.criterion: M_n,LB > 0, where M_n = I_e,cap / I_d,max,H1 - 1 and M_n,LB is its lower uncertainty bound; the point difference I_e,cap - I_d,max is never the acceptance criterion; without uncertainty evidence (a lower bound) for the inputs HC-05 is NOT_EVALUATED; physics produces the currents and their uncertainties

HC-06.criterion: temperature margin >= 50 K below the validated hardware-bound temperature limits (config/hardware/hardware_bounds_v1.json index); applied by assessment / protection logic, never inside thermal equations; physics produces temperatures / heat loads
provenance: registered protection / acceptance margin (former HC-06 literal THERMAL_MARGIN_MIN_K)

HC-07.criterion: predicted / measured subsystem firing life > the 15,000 h subsystem firing-life basis; the mission duration (26,280 h, operating scenario) is separate

HC-08.criterion: T_available(state) - D_spacecraft(state) >= 0 at every required state (statewise); physics computes T and D independently
provenance: AG-13, owner decision A9.13 S6.15 (former HC-08 literal STATEWISE_T_MINUS_D_MIN_N)

HC-09.criterion: intake-face drag <= 25 mN at every orbit state: F1-F8 design-generation filter (A9.22 G2 Option 1, read from the frozen engineering configuration, not RFP parsing) and reported in assessment; assessment-only (C-DRAG-RFP Option 2) needs a separate owner approval

HC-10.criterion: ambient atmospheric mode AND Xe contingency capability evaluated as architecture / capability evidence (1 = both demonstrated); no physics equation carries this requirement
provenance: A9.15 RFP-compliant propellant policy (former HC-10 literal PROPELLANT_CAPABILITY_MIN)

HC-11.criterion: feed_available - feed_required >= 0 (statewise feed-state sufficiency, registered formulation: minimum relative field margin); the requirement comes from the measured / validated H-1 performance basis when available and is never reduced to the presently achievable feed
provenance: AG-12, owner decision A9.13 S6.21 (former HC-11 literal FEED_STATE_SUFFICIENCY_MIN)

HC-12.criterion: compressor / plenum ripple <= measured H-1 ripple tolerance; threshold TBD until measured H-1 evidence establishes the permissible ripple basis; no default is invented
